about: Fort's comic skin, the one source for colours, strokes and type on the Mac, iPhone and web. The comic is the world (ink outlines on cream paper, golden-hour colours, caption boxes, speech bubbles); the game is the live layer (cyan holographic glow for work in progress, gold quest marks for what needs you). Run `node successor/design/tokens.mjs --write` after changing it.

line.use: Panel outlines and their hard offset shadows.

caption.use: Caption boxes: section labels and status lines. Text on it is always captionInk.

captionInk.use: Text on caption boxes, gold and status fills.

accent.use: Quest gold: the one primary action and what needs you.

working.use: Status: an agent is working. Holographic cyan.

glow.use: The holographic glow around live or selected things.

needsYou.use: Status: waiting on you. Same gold as the accent.

done.use: Status: finished. The Quest clear stamp.

failed.use: Status: failed. White text on it.

body.css: ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
